description: Official client for the HostTracker API v2: website uptime, blacklist, certificate and risk monitoring, instant checks from locations worldwide, monitors, contacts, webhooks and status pages.
rules: The package is hosttracker; install with pip install hosttracker and create a client with HostTracker(token=...).
Authenticate with an API token minted at https://www.host-tracker.com/integrations/api; tokens carry scopes per family (check, monitor, contact, subs, webhook, statuspage, account).
Timestamps on the wire are Unix seconds in both directions, never ISO strings.
List endpoints are cursor-paginated: pass the returned nextCursor back verbatim; never build a cursor.
Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents; branch on the machine code field, not on the HTTP status alone.
Bulk operations and report generation are asynchronous: they return a job id to poll.
